description: This file defines the OpenTypeDescriptor class, which is a specialized font descriptor for OpenType fonts within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for initializing font metrics, mapping characters to glyph indices, and handling font-specific details like widths, heights, and color records.

classes.name: OpenTypeDescriptor
classes.description: A sealed class representing an OpenType font descriptor, providing metrics and glyph mapping functionalities for OpenType fonts.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Calculates and initializes font metrics such as ascender, descender, line spacing, and widths based on the font face data.

methods.name: BmpCodepointToGlyphIndex
methods.description: Maps a BMP Unicode character to a glyph index using the cmap format 4 segment mapping.

methods.name: SurrogatePairToGlyphIndex
methods.description: Maps a surrogate pair (high and low) to a glyph index using the cmap format 12 segment mapping.

methods.name: CodepointToGlyphIndex
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point (including outside BMP) to a glyph index using appropriate cmap format.

methods.name: GlyphIndexToPdfWidth
methods.description: Converts a glyph index to its width in PDF design units.

methods.name: GlyphIndexToEmWidth
methods.description: Converts a glyph index to width in em units for a specified em size.

methods.name: GlyphIndexToWidth
methods.description: Returns the width in font units for a given glyph index.

methods.name: GlyphIndicesFromString
methods.description: Returns an array of glyph index and code point pairs from a string.

methods.name: GlyphIndicesFromCodePoints
methods.description: Maps an array of Unicode code points to glyph indices.

methods.name: GetColorRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the color layer record associated with a glyph index, if any.

methods.name: RemapSymbolChar
methods.description: Remaps a character for symbol fonts to match the cmap type 4 table's expectations.

methods.name: IsSymbolFont
methods.description: Indicates whether the font is a symbol font based on its cmap.
